title: PHP-FPM pool sizing: 2GB, 4GB and 8GB VPS, compared
lede: A WooCommerce shop crashes at lunch. PHP-FPM is at 100% pool capacity and the host wants you to size up the VPS. Before you click, here's the math.
hero_alt: Overhead still life on bone linen: PHP-FPM tuning worksheet, manila folder, brass key, fountain pen, red wax seal.
